g_ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

f_ir.name: weighted_advantage_margin_logsigmoid_scaled_weighted_mean_log_loss_v4
f_ir.intuition: Fixed similarity by changing the aggregation to a weighted mean over per-sample log_loss calculated using a debiased normalization of the advantage gap norm. Also incorporated a normalized weighted mean in place of sum-based normalization to break similarity with prior sum losses. Shift margin computed from weighted mean advantage to reflect weighted statistics accurately.
f_ir.pseudocode:
norm = max(norm(advantage_gap), epsilon)
weight_sum = sum(weight)
weighted_mean_adv = sum(advantage_gap * weight) / weight_sum
sign_adv = sign(weighted_mean_adv)
margin = clamp(abs(weighted_mean_adv), 0, 1)
shift = sign_adv * margin * 0.5
x = alpha * scale * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / norm
x = x - shift
x = clamp(x, -20, 20)
log_loss = -logsigmoid(x)
loss = log_loss * weight
return sum(loss) / weight_sum
f_ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.5))
    epsilon = 1e-6

    norm_adv_gap = ops.maximum(ops.norm(advantage_gap), epsilon)
    weight_sum = ops.maximum(ops.sum(weight), epsilon)
    weighted_mean_adv = ops.div(ops.sum(ops.mul(advantage_gap, weight)), weight_sum)
    sign_adv = ops.sign(weighted_mean_adv)
    margin = ops.clamp(ops.abs(weighted_mean_adv), 0.0, 1.0)
    shift = ops.mul(sign_adv, ops.mul(margin, 0.5))

    x = ops.mul(alpha * scale, ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), norm_adv_gap))
    x = ops.sub(x, shift)
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)

    log_loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    weighted_log_loss = ops.mul(log_loss, weight)

    loss = ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_log_loss), weight_sum)
    return loss
